messages.body: Draft board update attached: results against plan, the top three risks and the hiring plan.
Lead with the client numbers. Keep it to two pages.
My list: desk hiring, response time and one large firm renewal. Happy to discuss.
Next check-in is set. KPIs first, then the growth initiatives.
Two items hold the {month:-1} close: deferred revenue roll-forward and bank reconciliation. All should clear this week.
Feedback from the last firm survey is in. Response time is the main ask.
Pipeline for the open roles is attached. Offers are out for two.
Open items for the {month:-1} close: deferred revenue roll-forward and bank reconciliation.
Please send the {month:-1} pack when ready. P&L first if the rest takes longer.
Reminder: the compliance certificate is due with the next test.
Payroll ran on plan last month. Detail by team is attached.
Draft 2 of next year's budget is in the finance folder. Revenue plan by line is updated.
Fieldwork dates are set. Please confirm the request list owners.
38 roles are still open across the company. Overtime covers the gap for now.
Please bring the KPI trend and the two biggest drivers to the review.
A laptop vendor pushed delivery a week. New hires get loaners until then.
Notes from the ticket quality audit are attached. Two follow-ups.
A firm escalated a slow ticket. I called them; we have a plan.
Overtime is running above plan. Can we review it at the weekly meeting?
Let us review the top deals by stage before the leadership meeting.
Thanks for the proposal. We have questions on scope and timing.
The updated proposal template is in the shared folder.
Notes from the last two losses: price on one, timing on the other.
Results from last month's campaigns are in the dashboard.
We plan to renew. Can we talk about adding services?
Your invoice was rejected for a task code. Please correct and resubmit.
New rates are approved from the next billing cycle.
Two appeals are with the client. Expect answers this week.
Updated guidelines attached. Expense receipts are now required for every line.
Unpaid over 60 days is attached by client.
Your portal access is renewed.
